content.text:
I found an entity flood, cleaned it up without a restart, and the server is back to normal. I've filed the incident report.

- **What happened:** At about 07:28, someone used RCON (remote console access) to summon 452 pigs near spawn. Commands then ran through those pigs and dropped about 1,800 junk items (bones, dirt, sand, flint). Entities jumped from 24 to about 2,284 and server load roughly doubled, though TPS stayed at 20 the whole time. It stopped growing on its own after one burst. No player or plugin caused it.
- **What I did:** I declared the incident, then removed the 452 command-spawned pigs. The one real pig, Wilbur (named), is untouched. I also cleared every dropped item on the server, 2,001 in total. Before clearing, I checked that all of them were flood junk and there were no items on the ground before the flood. The count was higher than 1,800 because the pigs dropped loot when they died.
- **Now:** Entities are back to the 24 baseline and load is back to normal. Nothing came back during about 50 seconds of watching afterwards.

There were no restarts, no bans and no file changes.

**Still open:** whoever has RCON access could do this again. The team should check who holds the RCON credentials and limit access.
